title: What is SWP in Mutual Funds? How It Works, Benefits and Tax Rules (2026)
seoTitle: What is SWP in Mutual Funds? Meaning, Benefits & Tax 2026
seoDescription: SWP lets you withdraw a fixed sum from a mutual fund regularly. How it works, who it suits, and 2026 tax rules: 20% STCG, 12.5% LTCG above ₹1.25 lakh.
excerpt: An SWP (Systematic Withdrawal Plan) pays you a fixed amount from your mutual fund every month or quarter while the rest stays invested. Here is how it works, who it suits, and the current tax rules for equity and debt funds in 2026.
